_doc: PROGRESS-TRAILER PT8 (E468, §3.4): every sound the film may use. `file` is relative to the SFX scratch folder (`root`). recorded = the build's own AudioContext output (era-audio.mjs; lead = seconds of pre-roll before the call / the take's frame 0); extracted = the file that build played, from its own tree (`source` = sha:path); generated = MOSS-SoundEffect v2 vs Stable Audio 3 Medium, CLAP-picked (sfx_pick.py). Days 1 and 8 synthesise what has no file; days 8, 15 and 22 play the files listed under each recording.
head: d842621d44cdd972fda2e6144aceed9f772f74e0
credits: Sound effects: MOSS-SoundEffect v2 · Stable Audio 3 Medium — Powered by Stability AI
notes: Day 8 (2d2c5815a) DOES ship SFX files: public/assets/sfx/best (81 files, the default 'best' set). Its Pine Hollow sounds are those files; Driftwood's sword whooshes, blade impacts and boar barks are the procedural IslandSfx bank and its ambience is IslandAmbience (synth) over the bed-island loop, so day 8 is both recorded (era-audio.mjs) and extracted.

Day 15 (19a434635) Nine Dragon Stack has no audio of its own: the rain square plays the engine defaults (the forest bed, pine-litter footsteps, the generic swordSwing); there is no rain or crowd sound on that build.

Day 22 (c9aaa62ab) Sky Reach (far-reach) is silent: no ambience, a 'silent' score, no hover sound (data/audio.ts routes only kit sword voices); the w3-hover take records -91 dBFS. Sunscar Dunes has no ambience; the whip's crack is the routed kit voice (cue.fire -> kit.swordSwing) synthesised in WebAudio, recorded.

The real-time rewind takes on days 15 and 22 missed the stag (boltImpact-ground); the day-22 impact and kill were recorded through the crossbow's own handlers (weapons.onImpact('flesh') / weapons.onHit(..., killed)) and their files extracted. The day-22 isolated recordings carry Pine Hollow's zoned beds at about -35 dBFS under them (setAmbient does not mute them): use the extracted files as stems.

Generated families: MOSS-SoundEffect v2 could not run on 2026-10-10: its memory gate (~/ml/music/mem-ok2.sh) refused for 50+ min (swap used 51 GB, fseventsd at 44 GB) while the model held the machine lock, so it was stopped; the picks are Stable Audio 3 Medium only (3 seeds). Re-roll MOSS with scripts/music/gen/gen_sfx_moss.py --jobs scripts/progress-trailer/sfx-jobs.json when the gate opens, then re-run sfx_pick.py.

tr-subswell: all three Stable Audio takes are a decaying sub boom, not a rising swell; sfx-best/tr-subswell-rev.wav is the pick reversed (a swell into the drop). The alpha trailer's tr-subdrop (MOSS seed 2) is also on disk in trailer-reuse/.
